items.title: Agentic Observability: Automated Alert Triage for Adobe E-Commerce
items.title_zh: 智能体可观测性：Adobe 电商的自动化告警分诊
items.summary: The paper presents an agentic observability framework deployed in Adobe's e-commerce infrastructure that autonomously triages alerts using a ReAct paradigm, identifying affected services, correlating logs and planning actions such as handbook consultation or retrieval-augmented analysis of recent code. Production results reportedly show a 90% reduction in mean time to insight versus manual triage while maintaining comparable diagnostic accuracy.

items.title: Optimizing Agentic Reasoning with Retrieval via Synthetic Semantic Information Gain Reward
items.title_zh: 通过合成语义信息增益奖励优化智能体检索推理
items.summary: InfoReasoner is a framework that rewards agentic retrieval with a synthetic semantic information-gain signal, redefining information gain as uncertainty reduction over the model's belief states and estimating it from output distributions via semantic clustering. Trained with GRPO, it reportedly outperforms strong retrieval-augmented baselines across seven QA benchmarks by up to 5.4% average accuracy.

items.title: Uncertainty and Fairness Awareness in LLM-Based Recommendation Systems
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的推荐系统中的不确定性与公平性意识
items.summary: The paper introduces a benchmark with curated metrics and a dataset annotated for eight demographic attributes across movies and music, and studies how uncertainty and fairness evaluations affect LLM recommendation quality. It reports that Gemini 1.5 Flash shows systematic unfairness for some sensitive attributes, with similarity-based gaps of 0.1363 (SNSR) and 0.0507 (SNSV) that persist under typographical and multilingual prompt perturbations.

items.title: Learning Abstractions for Hierarchical Planning in Program-Synthesis Agents
items.title_zh: 程序合成 Agent 分层规划中的抽象学习
items.summary: TheoryCoder-2 is a theory-based reinforcement-learning agent that uses LLM in-context learning to synthesize reusable abstractions from experience and integrate them into hierarchical planning. It is reported to be more sample-efficient than several baselines on BabyAI, MiniHack and VGDL games such as Sokoban.

items.title: Continuous-Utility Direct Preference Optimization
items.title_zh: 连续效用直接偏好优化
items.summary: CU-DPO replaces binary preference labels with continuous scores that capture fine-grained reasoning quality and aligns models to a portfolio of prompt-based cognitive strategies. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks it reportedly raises strategy-selection accuracy from 35-46% to 68-78% across seven base models, with downstream gains up to +6.6 points and transfer to code generation and causal reasoning.

items.title: Beyond Output Critique: Self-Correction via Task Distillation
items.title_zh: 超越输出批评：通过任务蒸馏实现自我纠正
items.summary: SELF-THOUGHT inserts a task-abstraction step before solution refinement, distilling an input and initial response into a structured template of key variables, constraints and problem structure that guides a revised answer. The authors show these abstractions can transfer from larger to smaller models, improving accuracy, robustness and generalization on diverse reasoning tasks without heavy fine-tuning or external verifiers.

items.title: Domain-Adaptive and Scalable Dense Retrieval for Content-Based Recommendation
items.title_zh: 面向内容推荐领域自适应且可扩展的稠密检索
items.summary: The paper casts content-based recommendation as retrieval and fine-tunes a two-tower bi-encoder on Amazon Reviews 2023 (Fashion) with supervised contrastive learning. On a review-to-title benchmark over 826,402 items it reportedly raises Recall@10 from 0.26 with BM25 to 0.66, with 6.1 ms median CPU latency and a 4x model-size reduction using FAISS HNSW and INT8 ONNX Runtime.

items.title: nolabs-ai/nono
items.title_zh: nono：零信任、零配置的 Agent 运行时沙箱
items.summary: A Rust project that advertises zero-trust, zero-setup and zero-latency sandboxing for agent runtimes.

items.title: proma-ai/Proma
items.title_zh: Proma：面向专业用户的通用 Agent 工作流
items.summary: A TypeScript project that aims to bring a general-purpose agent experience into professional workflows, pitched at the "proactive Agent era".

items.title: Communications-Incentivized Collaborative Reasoning in NetGPT through Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: NetGPT 中通过智能体强化学习激励的协作推理
items.summary: The paper proposes a unified agentic NetGPT framework for AI-native next-generation networks, in which a core model either reasons autonomously or delegates sub-tasks to domain-specialized agents through agentic communication. It trains collaborative reasoning with agentic reinforcement learning under partial observability, using masked loss, entropy-guided exploration and multi-objective rewards to balance internal reasoning with agent invocation.
